description: This file defines a PHP class 'jirarestInterface' which extends 'issueTrackerInterface'. It serves as an interface to Jira's REST API, providing methods for connecting to Jira, retrieving, creating, and commenting on issues, as well as managing configurations for interacting with Jira's issue tracking system. It also includes methods for fetching issue types, priorities, and custom fields, and for preparing configurations templates.

classes.name: jirarestInterface
classes.description: A PHP class that interfaces with Jira's REST API to perform issue management operations including create, retrieve, and comment, along with configuration management.

methods.name: getIssueAttr
methods.description: Returns the attributes of a Jira issue.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes and sets default values for the configuration parameters.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Returns the Jira API client instance.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Checks if the issue ID has a valid syntax.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to Jira and tests login.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the connection to Jira is established.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves Jira issue details for a given issue ID.

methods.name: getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the status code of a Jira issue.

methods.name: getIssueStatusVerbose
methods.description: Returns a verbose, HTML string representation of the issue status.

methods.name: getIssueSummaryHTMLString
methods.description: Returns HTML string of the issue's summary.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence

methods.name: addIssue

methods.name: addNote

methods.name: getIssueTypes

methods.name: getPriorities
methods.description: Retrieves issue priorities from Jira.

methods.name: getVersions
methods.description: Retrieves project versions from Jira.

methods.name: getComponents
methods.description: Retrieves project components from Jira.

methods.name: getCreateIssueFields
methods.description: Retrieves fields required to create an issue.

methods.name: getIssueTypesForHTMLSelect

methods.name: getPrioritiesForHTMLSelect
methods.description: Returns priorities formatted for an HTML select element.

methods.name: getVersionsForHTMLSelect
methods.description: Returns versions formatted for an HTML select element.

methods.name: getComponentsForHTMLSelect
methods.description: Returns components formatted for an HTML select element.

methods.name: objectAttrToIDName
methods.description: Converts an array of objects with 'id' and 'name' attributes into an associative array keyed by 'id'.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template configuration XML for Jira integration.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Checks if the current configuration allows creating issues via API.

methods.name: processAttributes

methods.name: getCustomFieldsAttribute

methods.name: setResolvedStatusCfg

methods.name: getUserAccountID
